lines.t: If one comes to You, seeking grace,
Falling down and lifting their face,
You wash them clean in mercy’s flood,
A continual washing in Your blood.
Seven times, or seventy more,
Still You open Heaven’s door,
Your arms remain, unchanging, wide,
To the broken and contrite inside.
You forgive, You restore,
Your love forever more.
Beloved, by this then, we see—
Your love made perfect in me.
You forgive, You restore,
Your mercy I adore.
Blameless, I stand before You, Lord.
I shall abstain from what defiles,
Turn away from worldly trials.
Depart from all abomination,
To walk in holy consecration.
I’ll strive to live completely free,
A living sacrifice to Thee.
My heart made pure, my spirit raised,
All my soul in endless praise.
You forgive, You restore,
Your love forever more.
Beloved, by this then, we see—
Your love made perfect in me.
You forgive, You restore,
Your mercy I adore.
Blameless, I stand before You, Lord.
When I fall, You call me near,
Whisper truth to calm my fear.
With humble heart, I come again,
Your grace sustains me to the end.
You forgive, You restore,
Your love forever more.
Beloved, by this then, we see—
Your love made perfect in me.
You forgive, You restore,
Your mercy I adore.
Blameless, I stand
before You, Lord.
Blameless… I stand before You, Lord.
